mentions.name: Story of Us
mentions.description: A local-first relationship analysis app that works from personal iMessage chat dumps. Instead of sending private conversations to an AI service, it runs discovery locally and uses statistical AI to generate relationship insights while keeping chats on the device.
mentions.problem: Relationship analysis tools built on AI services require handing over all personal chats; the author wanted the same insights without giving AI access to private conversations.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://storyofus.app

I saw one Anthropic MTS got married recently and he did bunch of relationship analysis through iMessage dump in Claude Code. Started with that idea, but I don't want AI to have all my personal chats, so gave it a local first discovery and just statistical AI and I really like it right now.
mentions.author: vivekkairi
